# VoltMapEV

> VoltMapEV is an EV charging station discovery and range-aware trip-planning application for India.

Canonical site: https://voltmapev.com/
Public guide: https://voltmapev.com/ev-charging-stations-india.html
City charger guides: https://voltmapev.com/charging-stations/
Contact: skotla100@gmail.com, +91 93927 88714

## Public features

- Search EV charging stations by PIN code, area, city, or state.
- Review 29,251 deduplicated, geocoded BEE inventory records dated 26 October 2025.
- Browse crawlable city guides for Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Jaipur, and Kochi.
- Plan EV routes and see relevant chargers near the route.
- View matching search results inside VoltMapEV and optionally use Google Maps for verification.

## Data and payment transparency

The Government of India aggregate total and BEE station inventory are sourced and dated. Station operation, availability, prices, and route stops are not a complete real-time feed and should be verified before travel. The current checkout is a sandbox and does not accept or move real money.
